comment: The chapter refers to interoperability as being realised through “the information mediator and shared terminology,” although Section 3.6 deliberately avoids treating an information mediator as a required single component.

anchor.note: p.105-106 l.Lines 62-65 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: The chapter refers to interoperability as being realised through “the information mediator and shared terminology,” although Section 3.6 deliberately avoids treating an information mediator as a required single component.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with wording consistent with Section 3.6: “realised through shared specifications, terminology, information models, trust arrangements, and appropriate exchange or mediation mechanisms.”
